name: Alexa

summary.text: Alexa is Amazon's voice assistant. At Amazon's re:MARS conference in Las Vegas in June 2022, Rohit Prasad, Alexa's senior vice president and head scientist, demonstrated an in-development feature in which Alexa read a bedtime story to a child in the voice of the child's deceased grandmother, generated from less than a minute of recorded audio. Amazon did not say when or whether the feature would be released.

sources.title: Amazon demonstrates Alexa mimicking the voice of a deceased relative

facts.claim: At re:MARS in June 2022 Amazon showed a video in which a child asks Alexa to finish a book in his late grandmother's voice, and Alexa switched from its default voice to one mimicking the family member.
facts.quote: Alexa confirmed the request with the default, robotic voice, then immediately switched to a softer, more humanlike tone, seemingly mimicking the child's family member.

sources.title: Amazon demonstrates Alexa mimicking the voice of a deceased relative

facts.claim: Prasad said the Alexa team had developed a model that can produce a high-quality voice from less than a minute of recorded audio, framed as a voice-conversion task rather than speech generation.
facts.quote: less than a minute of recorded audio

facts.claim: Prasad presented the feature as a way to keep memories alive after pandemic losses; Amazon declined to say when it would roll out.
